name: 2D Full-Color LED Array Rotational Display
definition: A system using a 2D full-color LED array rotation to display volumetric images. It updates 512 display images per rotation of the LED array to create the volumetric image without requiring synchronization with external devices like electron beams or lasers.
summary: A 2D full-color LED array rotational display renders volumetric images by rotating an LED panel and synchronously updating it, generating voxels directly on an emissive surface without external synchronization.
